$comment: Lint rule DSL executed by linter/engine.js. Built-in rules live in linter/rules/*.json; personal rules go in ~/.kube-localization-helper/user-lint-rules.json (same array shape), loaded last and merged by id — a user rule with the same id overrides a built-in one.

message.description: Bilingual explanation shown in the diagnostic.

id.description: Stable unique slug, e.g. "ascii-punctuation". A user rule with the same id overrides a built-in rule of that id.

kind.description: Which engine handler runs this rule; determines which other fields apply.

pattern.description: kind: regex only. The pattern to flag; every match becomes a diagnostic.

flags.description: kind: regex only. Regex flags; defaults to "gu" (the "g" is added automatically if omitted).

includeInlineCode.description: kind: regex only. By default matches inside inline code spans (`...`) are skipped; set true to also check inside them.

ifMatches.description: kind: lineMustMatch only. Lines matching this pattern are checked against mustAlsoMatch.

mustAlsoMatch.description: kind: lineMustMatch only. A qualifying line must match this pattern in full, else the whole line is flagged.

key.description: kind: frontmatterKeyForbidden only. The front-matter key (e.g. "reviewers") that must not be present.

beforeMessage.description: kind: codeSpanSpacing only. Message when the code span is missing a space before it. Falls back to `message` if omitted.

afterMessage.description: kind: codeSpanSpacing only. Message when the code span is missing a space after it. Falls back to `message` if omitted.

endMarkers.description: kind: prosePairMustEndWith only. Characters a prose line should end with when immediately followed by another prose line.
